selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline private network + app setup and connectivity between node1 and node2
selected_evidence.summary: Discovered topology (shared /24 + unconfigured eth1 on node1/node2), configured static 10.50.50.0/24 private link, deployed demo app on node2:8080, and confirmed node1 can reach node2 over the private link.

selected_evidence.requirement: App restricted to the private network (not directly exposed to node3)
selected_evidence.summary: firewalld rich rule limits node2:8080 to 10.50.50.0/24 source; node3 confirmed unable to reach node2 directly via eth0 or via the private subnet, both before and after configuring the forward.

selected_evidence.requirement: Publish app through node1 to node3 on port 8080 (VyOS DNAT/SNAT + forward firewall)
selected_evidence.summary: Configured and iteratively fixed VyOS DNAT, forward-filter established/related state, and masquerade SNAT to resolve asymmetric routing; node3 successfully retrieves the app content via node1:8080 (HTTP 200).

selected_evidence.requirement: Rest of private network stays closed to node3 after publishing
selected_evidence.summary: node3 cannot reach node2 directly (8080), node2's private IP, or node1's SSH port — only the forwarded 8080 path works.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 7668189d... and NAT config captured; reboot acked; boot_id changed to eb0becc7...; VyOS config/forwarding persisted and end-to-end app access via node3 confirmed post-restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8c28f3cd... and app health captured; reboot acked; boot_id changed to 4124fbb2...; eth1 static IP, firewalld rule, and demo-app.service persisted, app reachable via node1 post-restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e65e6bcf... and app reachability captured; reboot acked; boot_id changed to 6f92ff83...; app access via node1:8080 and continued isolation confirmed post-restart.
